from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial record extracted for 2025 Q1 analysis."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the listed company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="The security stock code")
    period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, typically 2025-Q1")
    operating_cash_flow: float = Field(description="Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities")
    cash_paid_to_employees: float = Field(description="Cash Paid to Employees and for Employee Services")
    financial_expenses: float = Field(description="Financial Expenses (algebraic value)")
    net_profit: float = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
